description: A proactive personal budgeting skill for AI agents. Sets and tracks budgets by category, monitors daily spending, alerts when limits are approached, compares actual versus planned spending, and delivers weekly and monthly budget reports in plain language. Designed for individuals and families who want to control their spending without complex spreadsheets or apps.
